title: No Matter How Much
goal: Say that no amount of effort changes the result, with por más que, por mucho que and por muy... que + the subjunctive.

items: I can say that no amount of effort changes the result, using por más que and por mucho que with the subjunctive.
I can use por muy + adjective + que + subjunctive for "however difficult it is".
I can use the new words for effort and insistence.
